description_en: Queries clusters that are registered in DataWorks. E-MapReduce (EMR) clusters and Cloudera's Distribution Including Apache Hadoop (CDH) clusters are supported
description_zh: 列出注册到 DataWorks 的集群信息，目前支持 EMR 集群、CDH 集群
name: ListClusters

parameters.help_en:
The type of the cluster. Valid values:

CDH: CDH cluster
EMR: EMR cluster
parameters.help_zh:
集群类型，支持的集群类型如下：
CDH（CDH 集群）
EMR（EMR 集群）
parameters.name: cluster_type

parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages start from page 1
parameters.help_zh: 页码，大于等于 1 的正整数，默认为 1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 每页记录数，默认为 10 条，最大 100 条
parameters.name: page_size
